somitoid_rosette_specimen.species: Vertebrate dorsal embryo scanning electron micrograph showing bilateral epithelialized somite rosettes flanking the neural tube

rosette_metrics.provenance_note_pass3: Scout-stage hand counts. The script's DoG segmentation (segment_somite_rosette_specimen) finds upper=8 / lower=10 rosettes, bilateral mean spacing 45.375 px, CV 0.2391 and dome/cleft contrast 1.2315; the two sets have not been reconciled and the discrepancy is carried as an open Pass 4 item rather than silently overwriting either value.

somite_rosette_vertex_governing_equation.section: Adhyapok et al. (2021) Dev. Cell 56:1312-1324; Yamanaka et al. (2023) Nature 614:509-520; Miao et al. (2023) Nature 614:500-508
somite_rosette_vertex_governing_equation.vertex_interfacial_energy_functional: E = sum_{i=1}^N [ (K_A / 2) * (A_i - A_0)^2 + gamma_ap * L_{ap,i} + gamma_lat * L_{lat,i} + gamma_bas * L_{bas,i} ]
somite_rosette_vertex_governing_equation.radial_wedge_rosette_energy: E(R_in, N) = 2 * pi * gamma_ap * R_in + 2 * pi * gamma_bas * R_out + N * gamma_lat * (R_out - R_in),  with R_out = sqrt(R_in^2 + N * A_0 / pi)
somite_rosette_vertex_governing_equation.wedge_angle_law: theta_wedge = 2 * pi / N,  L_ap = (2 * pi / N) * R_in < L_bas = (2 * pi / N) * R_out
somite_rosette_vertex_governing_equation.apical_basal_curvature_balance: dE/dR_in = 2 * pi * gamma_ap - N * gamma_lat + (2 * pi * gamma_bas + N * gamma_lat) * (R_in / R_out) = 0
somite_rosette_vertex_governing_equation.analytical_equilibrium_lumen_radius: R_in / R_out = (N * gamma_lat - 2 * pi * gamma_ap) / (N * gamma_lat + 2 * pi * gamma_bas)  for 2 * pi * gamma_ap < N * gamma_lat
somite_rosette_vertex_governing_equation.eph_ephrin_cleft_sorting_energy: Delta_E_cleft = 2 * L_cleft * (gamma_het - (gamma_ant + gamma_post) / 2) > 0  when gamma_het > (gamma_ant + gamma_post) / 2

state_variables.R_in: Central somitecoel lumen radius (um), bounded by F-actin/ZO-1/pMLC2-enriched apical domain
state_variables.R_out: Outer somite rosette basal radius (um), bounded by Fibronectin/Laminin/Matrigel basal lamina
state_variables.gamma_ap: Apical actomyosin cortical line tension (pN/um), elevated by RhoA/ROCK/pMLC2 during MET
state_variables.gamma_bas: Basal cell-ECM interfacial tension (pN/um), lowered by Matrigel/fibronectin integrin engagement
state_variables.gamma_lat: Lateral N-cadherin (CDH2) homophilic cell-cell interfacial tension (pN/um)
state_variables.gamma_het: Heterotypic EphA4/ephrinB2 inter-somitic boundary line tension driving somite cleft separation

shell_3d_governing_equations.section: Yamanaka et al. (2023) Figs. 2-3 somitecoel lumen; Gomez-Galvez et al. (2018) Nat Commun 9:2960 scutoid packing
shell_3d_governing_equations.polyhedral_shell_energy: E_3D = sum_i [ (K_V/2) (V_i - V_0)^2 + gamma_ap A_ap,i + gamma_bas A_bas,i ] + gamma_lat sum_faces A_lat,ij - P V_lumen
shell_3d_governing_equations.frustum_cell_geometry: A_ap,i = Omega_i R_in,i^2, A_bas,i = Omega_i R_out,i^2, V_i = Omega_i (R_out,i^3 - R_in,i^3)/3, A_lat,ij = l_ij (Rbar_out,ij^2 - Rbar_in,ij^2)/2; Omega_i and l_ij from the spherical Voronoi diagram of N_3D Fibonacci-sphere seeds
shell_3d_governing_equations.uniform_shell_radial_balance: 4 pi gamma_ap - Lambda + rho (4 pi gamma_bas + Lambda) = 2 pi P R_in,  Lambda = gamma_lat sum_ij l_ij / 2,  R_out^3 = R_in^3 + 3 N_3D V_0 / (4 pi)
shell_3d_governing_equations.equilibrium_lumen_ratio_3d: rho_3D = R_in/R_out = (Lambda - 4 pi gamma_ap + 2 pi P R_in) / (Lambda + 4 pi gamma_bas)
shell_3d_governing_equations.scutoid_statement: Radial frusta share one apical/basal neighbour graph -> scutoid fraction 0; Gomez-Galvez (2018) predicts scutoids only under anisotropic (tubular) curvature or lateral rearrangement, neither of which this reduced model contains

reference_values.cross_section_lumen_ratio_source: Yamanaka et al. (2023) Figs. 2-3 (same empirical ratio used for the 2D law; a cross-section of the 3D shell measures the same R_in/R_out)
reference_values.somitocoel_pressure: not reported in Yamanaka 2023 / Miao 2023 / Adhyapok 2021; P_crit is referenced only to the model-internal Laplace bound

hes7_clock_wavefront.section: Lewis (2003) Curr Biol 13:1398-1408; Cooke & Zeeman (1976) J Theor Biol 58:455-476; Diaz-Cuadros et al. (2020) Nature 580:113-118; Matsuda et al. (2020) Nature 580:124-129; Yamanaka et al. (2023) Fig. 4 MESP2/RIPPLY2 stripes
hes7_clock_wavefront.delayed_oscillator: dm/dt = k / (1 + (p(t - T_m)/p_0)^2) - c m ;  dp/dt = a m(t - T_p) - b p
hes7_clock_wavefront.time_scale_rule: all rates divided and all delays multiplied by time_scale, calibrated so the period equals target_period_h
hes7_clock_wavefront.target_period_source: Diaz-Cuadros et al. (2020) and Matsuda et al. (2020): human iPSC-derived PSM HES7 reporter period ~5 h (mouse ~2-2.5 h)
hes7_clock_wavefront.wavefront_law: x_wf(t) = v t ; cell j arrested at t_a,j = x_j / v ; segment length S = v T_HES7
hes7_clock_wavefront.mesp2_rule: MESP2 induced in arrested cells whose frozen HES7 protein is below the limit-cycle median (NICD high when HES7 low) -> anterior half-segment, EphA4+; MESP2- arrested cells -> posterior half-segment, ephrinB2+
hes7_clock_wavefront.ripply2_rule: RIPPLY2 ramps 1 - exp(-(t - t_a - tau_RIPPLY2)/0.5 h) after MESP2; boundary determination t_det when the anterior-most MESP2+ cell crosses RIPPLY2 = 0.5
hes7_clock_wavefront.boundary_rule: boundary between an ephrinB2+ anterior neighbour and an EphA4+ posterior neighbour (Adhyapok et al. 2021 heterotypic contact)

canonical_parameters.parameter_status: v, tau_ROCK, tau_Eph and tau_RIPPLY2 are model choices (segment ~100 um, MET over ~1 clock period); they are NOT digitised from Yamanaka 2023 and are carried as an open calibration item

somitoid_experimental_regimes.label: WT Axioloid/Somitoid (+10% Matrigel, active ROCK/pMLC2 + EphA4/ephrinB2)
Low Matrigel (2.5% ECM, partially elevated gamma_bas = 0.95)
EphA4 / ephrinB2 boundary knockdown (gamma_het = 1.05, impaired clefting)
Y-27632 ROCK / Blebbistatin Myosin II inhibition (gamma_ap -> gamma_bas = 0.45)
Minus-Matrigel suspension control (0% ECM, unpolarized gamma_ap = gamma_bas = 0.72)
